flags.note: Radial map: only distance from centre means anything (1 − cosine); angle is layout. Easy to misread as clusters though stated in the caption.
Rows retrieved are orange, but ★ also marks all right passages even when not retrieved; at k=1 the orange row (G2) and the star meanings are easy to confuse. Minor.

Only one grader's table is shown at a time; which answer the plain LLM judge gets wrong (4/5) is not visible in the default view, so the vague 'Limits vary…' answer's grading by the plain judge is unclear.
